_notes: Desired configuration record for the grokbot-image-publish protected environment.
Owner/repo (swcstudiospace/Omega-Prime) resolved at authoring time from the checkout remote via `git remote get-url origin`; never copied from prose.

The gh api PUT body is derived from this file by the parent-run command in docs/deploy.md: wait_timer, prevent_self_review, can_admins_bypass (false: no admin bypass), reviewers (numeric id resolved at apply time), and deployment_branch_policy are sent. environment_name, required_reviewers, and _notes are record-keeping only.
